# VexFlow notation study dependency

VexFlow 5.0.0 is used under its MIT licence. The unmodified production
vexflow-bravura.js bundle, LICENSE and AUTHORS are from the official npm archive,
verified with its published SHA-512 integrity and pinned source commit in manifest.json.

The bundle embeds Bravura and Academico (including bold) fonts by Steinberg Media
Technologies GmbH, distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Full notices,
reserved font names and terms are retained in bravura-OFL.txt and academico-OFL.txt;
these copies come from the official @vexflow-fonts packages, also recorded in the manifest.
The three embedded font byte streams match the corresponding official package
woff2 files exactly. No fonts are renamed or edited. The application remains GPL; these assets retain
their own licences. No CDN or remote font request is needed at runtime.

Official sources:
- https://github.com/vexflow/vexflow/tree/0ca6f889545c33cce851b420c24945f6eb685aeb
- https://github.com/vexflow/vexflow-fonts/tree/main/bravura
- https://github.com/vexflow/vexflow-fonts/tree/main/academico
- https://vexflow.github.io/vexflow-docs/api/5.0.0/classes/VexFlow.html
